00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000003.title: The last ferry
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000003.synopsis: At the mainland harbor, a reluctant ferryman recognizes Mara’s name—and knows more than he is willing to say.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000003.notes: Introduce Tomas through what he does, not a description. He should never answer a question directly.

00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000004.title: What the tide kept
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000004.synopsis: The crossing reveals how much the island has changed. A familiar landmark appears on the wrong side of the boat.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000004.notes: A quiet scene between discoveries. Give Mara space to remember.
